reviews.question: Paraphrase ba lần cho mỗi câu, dùng đa dạng cấu trúc và từ vựng nhưng giữ nguyên hoàn toàn ý nghĩa gốc.
reviews.originalEssay:
Câu 1: "Many people believe that money is one of the most important factors in achieving happiness."
It is widely thought that financial wealth plays a key role in attaining personal happiness.
Numerous individuals are of the opinion that money is a fundamental element that leads to a fulfilling life.
Wealth is considered by many to be a primary determinant of human happiness.
Câu 2: "Some people say that the best way to improve public health is by increasing the number of sports facilities. Others, however, believe this would have little effect."
While a group of people argues that expanding sports amenities is the most effective measure to enhance community health, opponents contend that such an approach would yield minimal results.
On the one hand, it is argued that building more athletic facilities is the optimal solution for boosting public health; on the other hand, some maintain that this initiative would make hardly any difference.
Certain individuals believe that the most ideal method for promoting population health is to construct more recreational facilities, whereas others claim that this strategy would be largely ineffective.
reviews.overall: Em đã làm đủ ba cách viết cho mỗi câu và phần câu B giữ được hai quan điểm. Tuy nhiên, cả ba bản của câu A đều làm mờ ý tiền là một trong những yếu tố quan trọng nhất. Đặc biệt, “fundamental element” và “primary determinant” khiến tiền trở thành yếu tố nền tảng hoặc quyết định. Em viết lại sáu câu theo mẫu gợi ý, rồi tự kiểm tra từng bản có giữ đúng toàn bộ ý gốc hay không.

annotations.label: a1-meaning
annotations.title: Chưa giữ đủ mức độ
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
“A key role” không nói rõ đây là một trong những yếu tố quan trọng nhất như câu gốc.

Dùng “is among the most important factors in achieving happiness”.

anchors.quote: financial wealth plays a key role in attaining personal happiness.

annotations.label: a2-meaning
annotations.title: Ý tiền bị mạnh hơn
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
“Fundamental element” khiến tiền trở thành yếu tố nền tảng, còn câu gốc chỉ nói đây là một trong những yếu tố quan trọng nhất.

Viết “money is one of the principal factors in attaining happiness”.

anchors.quote: money is a fundamental element that leads to a fulfilling life.

annotations.label: a3-meaning
annotations.title: Ý tiền bị đổi thành yếu tố quyết định
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
“A primary determinant” nói tiền quyết định hạnh phúc, mạnh hơn ý gốc.

Viết “Wealth is regarded by many as one of the most significant contributors to happiness”.

anchors.quote: Wealth is considered by many to be a primary determinant of human happiness.

annotations.label: b3-word-choice
annotations.title: Chọn từ sát nghĩa hơn
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
“Ideal” đã mang nghĩa tối ưu, còn “recreational facilities” gồm cả nơi giải trí không phải thể thao.

Viết “the most effective way to improve public health is to increase the number of sports facilities”.

anchors.quote: the most ideal method for promoting population health is to construct more recreational facilities

reviews.suggestedRevision:
Câu A
It is widely believed that financial resources are among the most important factors in achieving happiness.
Many individuals consider money to be one of the principal factors in the attainment of happiness.
Money is regarded by numerous people as one of the most significant contributors to happiness.

Câu B
Some people argue that the most effective way to improve public health is to increase the number of sports facilities, whereas others believe that this would have little effect.
It is considered by some that constructing additional sports facilities is the best way to improve public health; others, however, believe that this would make little difference.
Increasing the number of sports facilities is viewed by certain individuals as the most effective means of improving public health, while others claim that this measure would have little effect.

Em đã dùng chủ ngữ giả it và cách diễn đạt khác để giữ hai quan điểm.

Soát lại từng câu để từ thay thế không làm ý gốc mạnh hơn hoặc rộng hơn.

reviews.originalEssay: Hosting major professional sporting events, such as the World Cup or the Olympics, significantly boosts tourism and stimulates related commercial sectors. Consequently, this economic surge creates a wide range of employment opportunities for local residents, thereby improving their livelihoods.
reviews.overall: Em đã viết đủ ba mắt xích và giữ đúng chiều nguyên nhân, kết quả. World Cup và Olympics được nêu đúng là ví dụ của sự kiện thể thao chuyên nghiệp. Cách dùng Consequently và thereby làm quan hệ ý rõ ràng. Lần sau, em nên dừng ở cơ hội việc làm để bám sát chuỗi ý được giao.

reviews.question:
Advertisements are becoming more and more common in our everyday life.
Is it a positive or negative development?
reviews.originalEssay:
Advertisements are becoming increasingly common in our daily lives, especially on television, social media and websites. In my opinion, this is a negative development because advertisements can encourage unnecessary consumption and negatively affect people’s choices.

One major disadvantage of the growing number of advertisements is that they can encourage people to buy things they do not really need. For example, attractive advertisements for clothes, electronic devices and fast food may make consumers feel that they need to purchase these products to have a better lifestyle. As a result, people may waste money on unnecessary items. Moreover, children and teenagers can be particularly influenced by advertisements because they may not fully understand the persuasive purpose behind them.

Another problem is that advertisements can become annoying and distracting. People are often exposed to advertisements while watching videos, using social media or browsing websites. This can interrupt their activities and make it harder for them to concentrate. In addition, some advertisements may provide exaggerated or misleading information about products, which can cause consumers to make poor purchasing decisions.

In conclusion, although advertisements can help companies introduce their products to customers, I believe that their increasing presence in everyday life is a negative development. The unnecessary consumption, distraction and potential misinformation caused by advertising are significant concerns.
reviews.overall: Bài viết rõ ràng và hầu như không có lỗi ngữ pháp cơ bản, nhưng chưa làm theo dàn ý đã học. Em chỉ triển khai mặt hại, trong khi mở bài và kết bài phải nêu cả lợi ích lẫn tác hại; Body 1 cần hai lợi ích cho người tiêu dùng và kinh tế. Bài cũng mới có 213 từ, dưới mức tối thiểu 250 từ. Em viết lại theo đúng bố cục, giữ hai chuỗi tác hại ở Body 2 và kiểm tra đủ số từ trước khi nộp lại.

reviews.suggestedRevision:
Advertisements have become increasingly common in everyday life, appearing on television, social networking platforms and street billboards. I am firmly convinced that this development brings both benefits and drawbacks. While advertising can assist consumers and stimulate the economy, its persuasive and intrusive nature may also harm individuals.

On the positive side, commercials can provide consumers with a convenient and helpful buying experience. Television advertisements, pop-ups on social networking platforms and street billboards expose people to a wide range of goods available on the market. As a result, consumers can make wiser purchasing decisions instead of relying only on local brands. On a wider societal scale, advertising can also be a powerful driver of economic growth. Engaging content and appealing visual effects may stimulate customers’ demand and purchasing power, leading to increased production. This can generate employment opportunities and bring more revenue to the state budget.

However, advertising also has notable disadvantages. Persuasive advertisements can lure people into buying products that they may not otherwise need. When celebrities endorse these products, they may appear more trustworthy and desirable, so consumers can develop impulsive and wasteful buying habits. In addition, people may feel overwhelmed by the colossal number of advertisements. Social network users are often bombarded with pop-ups while gaming or watching films, and these messages can disrupt their online experience because they cannot always be turned off immediately.

In conclusion, the growing presence of advertising has both positive and negative effects. It helps consumers make informed choices and supports economic growth, but it can also encourage wasteful consumption and interrupt people’s online activities.
